invariant_argument: PhasePoint has public fields and its new method is only a raw record constructor. DiscreteWeylSystem carries a private modulus admitted once in 2..=256. All exported point arithmetic now calls the same relative coordinate gate, left operand before right. Composites support ring addition/alternating form; only ray generation requires primality.

For admitted coordinates each product is <=255 squared=65025 and sum <=510. Residues term1,term2<d make d+term1>=term2 and <=511, so modular subtraction never underflows. The exact result is the determinant modulo d, including even and composite d. Both addition results lie below d. No float, saturation, division by zero or unchecked large-operand arithmetic occurs.

Trial divisors 2..p find a proper divisor exactly for composite p. At a prime p, the vertical ray (0,y) and slope rays (x,m*x mod p) each have p distinct entries via their free coordinate. The actual field direction theorem gives a unique direction to each nonzero point, isotropy, and disjointness outside origin. Its Option-field direction count is p+1. Natural representatives compute those field coordinates exactly.

Generation owns one outer vector and one exact-capacity vector per required ray. At most 257*256 phase records are constructed by the admitted domain (the actual largest prime is 251). count_nonzero stores at most p*p-1 records and tests both output counts against the checked formula; failure is typed. Those checks corroborate this private generator; they are not a universal checker for arbitrary malformed raw ray matrices.

The independent inverse-classification oracle enumerates every coordinate and groups nonzero points by y/x or vertical, independently of production slope enumeration, for every prime modulus through 256. It compares complete ordered rays, checks each point with its direction anchor and verifies the distinct union/certificate. Every composite modulus is refused for rays. Exhaustive small-ring pairs and i128 determinant reduction also check signs, zero divisors, boundary moduli and both operand gates.

All 13 production bodies have structural maxima CCN 6, cognitive 7, nesting 2. Point operations have constant work/no heap allocation except an error diagnostic only when requested. Trial division is O(d), ray generation O(d squared) records with no redundant inner allocations, and union/certification O(d squared log d) set work/storage bounded by the admitted modulus. Standard collection allocation remains TCB. Returned raw vectors/count tuples carry no authority.

proof_correspondence.alternating: The determinant form on actual commutative-ring pairs vanishes on the diagonal, including composite modular rings.
proof_correspondence.antisymmetric: Swapping pair operands negates the exact determinant.
proof_correspondence.additive: Coordinatewise addition is additive in the determinant first argument.
proof_correspondence.ray_isotropic: Every two points of an actual projective field direction commute under the form.
proof_correspondence.unique_direction: Every nonzero point over a field has exactly one vertical/slope direction; admitted prime ZMod supplies that field.
proof_correspondence.distinct_directions_disjoint: Distinct field directions cannot share a nonzero point.
proof_correspondence.direction_count: A finite field has its cardinality plus one projective directions.
proof_correspondence.bundle_mass: Actual pairwise-disjoint finite bundles of size d-1 have union cardinality k*(d-1).
proof_correspondence.bundle_mass_bound: Global identity exclusion places that union in the d-squared-point ambient set minus one.
proof_correspondence.basis_count_bound: For d>=2 the actual mass inequality forces k<=d+1.
proof_correspondence.bounded_add: Representatives below d<=256 have a sum at most 510.
proof_correspondence.subtract_representative_safe: Adding d before subtracting a residue avoids unsigned underflow.
proof_correspondence.singleton_admission: Membership admission applies to singleton bundles even though no distinct pair exists.
proof_correspondence.bounded_plus_one: Exact dimension-plus-one representability is strict inequality against the machine maximum.
